bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar to Modernise 31 BSRTC Bus Stands on Gujarat's Model - Drishti IAS
bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar Prev Next Bihar to Modernise 31 BSRTC Bus Stands on Gujarat’s Model 29 Aug 2026 2 min read Why in News? The Bihar Government has approved the redevelopment of 31 Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC) bus stands on the lines of Gujarat’s modern GSRTC Bus Port model . Key Points Number of Bus Stands: 31 BSRTC bus depots will be modernised across Bihar. Model: The projects will be developed under the PPP model , with revenue from commercial activities shared between BSRTC and private partners. Bihar plans to replicate the GSRTC Bus Port model , which integrates transport facilities with commercial spaces. EV Infrastructure: The terminals will have EV charging stations , modern workshops, bus parking facilities, inspection pits and storage areas. Facilities such as Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs), drainage systems and backup power systems are also planned. Patna: The state capital is proposed to have Bihar’s largest bus terminal . Muzaffarpur: It is expected to develop as a major transit centre for North Bihar . Commercial Development: Around 3,000–5,000 shops could potentially be established across the 31 terminals. Revenue Generation: Commercial activities are expected to provide additional recurring revenue to BSRTC , helping meet operational and maintenance costs. bihar_raw_news.title: Higher Qualification Cannot Override Prescribed Eligibility for Lower-Qualification Posts - LawBeat
bihar_raw_news.content: Search Search Home Videos Login Profile Home / Top Stories / Supreme Court Judgments Higher Qualification Cannot Override Prescribed Eligibility for Lower-Qualification Posts: Supreme Court X Supreme Court says higher qualification cannot override prescribed eligibility. By - Lawbeat News Desk -SC & Salil Tiwari | 29 Aug 2026 4:00 PM IST The Supreme Court holds candidates with higher qualifications cannot be appointed to posts requiring lower qualifications, but orders Bihar to regularise technicians serving for over 15 years. The Supreme Court recently observed that permitting candidates with a higher qualification to participate in a selection process meant for candidates with a lower qualification results in depriving the genuinely eligible and deserving candidates, as it emphasised that selection processes must adhere strictly to the rules in vogue at the time of commencement. A Bench of Justices P S Narasimha and Alok Aradhe held that appointing candidates with higher qualifications to posts requiring lower qualifications is impermissible, as it deprives genuinely eligible candidates. What was the dispute over the appointments? The appeals arose from the recruitment of Lab Technicians/X-ray Technicians in government medical institutions in Bihar. The appellants, Kumar Praveen Pratap and others, had been appointed on different dates between 2005 and 2010 on a contractual basis to the posts of Lab Technician/X-ray Technician in Government Medical Institutions. The recruitment to these posts was governed by the Bihar Lab Technician Cadre Rules, 2014. On June 21, 2015, the Bihar Staff Selection Commission (BSSC) published an advertisement for regular appointments to the posts. The prescribed qualification was a Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT). The appellants participated in the selection process but possessed a Bachelor Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT), which was a higher qualification. During the counselling process, the Commission informed them that they did not possess the requisite qualification, namely the Diploma. Aggrieved by this, the appellants approached the high court. Their writ petition was disposed of on June 30, 2016, with a direction to the Commission to determine the eligibility of candidates on the basis of valid and recognised degrees/qualifications and consider candidates possessing valid higher qualifications. In compliance with the direction, the Commission permitted the appellants to participate in the selection process and completed their counselling. However, when the result for regular appointment was published on May 29, 2020, the appellants' names were not included. The appellants again approached the high court. On March 3, 2021, the single judge directed revision of the merit list and reconsideration of the appellants' inclusion in the list. The Commission challenged the order before a division bench of the high court. On December 6, 2023, the division bench allowed the Letters Patent Appeals filed by the Commission and set aside the single judge's order. The appellants also assailed the order dated December 14, 2021. What did the Supreme Court hold on higher qualifications? bihar_raw_news.title: Prime Group to invest ₹1,500 crore in Bihar real estate over next four quarters | Mint
bihar_raw_news.content: Prime Group to invest ₹1,500 crore in Bihar real estate over next four quarters Prime Group is set to invest ₹ 1,500 crore in Bihar's real estate, starting a major expansion with plans for 5 million sq ft of developments. The group aims to leverage its strong financial position and strategic partnerships for growth in the state. Focus Updated 29 Aug 2026, 03:49 PM IST Prime Group AI Quick Read Patna: P rime Group plans to invest around ₹ 1,500 crore in Bihar’s real estate market over the next four quarters, marking its mega entry into the state’s property sector as it builds a sizeable development portfolio in the region. The group plans a development pipeline of around 5 million sq ft and plans to deploy the proposed capital across residential and mixed-use developments in Bihar. The group’s broader development ecosystem and business associations extend across markets including Mumbai, Bengaluru, Kolkata and Ranchi, as it now looks to deepen its development footprint in Bihar. Prime Group currently has a zero-debt balance sheet, providing the group with financial flexibility as it scales its development pipeline in the state. The group has onboarded strategic investors from the Middle East, overseas architects and specialist consultants, for its upcoming developments. Details of these strategic tie-ups are expected to be announced in due course. The investment forms the first major phase of Prime Group’s expansion in Bihar, with the company evaluating multiple development opportunities across the state. “Bihar is entering an important phase of real estate growth, and we see significant opportunity in the market. The ₹ 1,500 crore investment marks the beginning of our expansion in the state,” said Chairman, Prime Group . The group plans to scale its development pipeline over the coming quarters, with details of new projects and strategic partnerships expected to be announced progressively. bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar Drops 'Fail' From Class 10 & 12 Marksheets; Replaces It With 'Eligible for Skill Training'
bihar_raw_news.content: News Bihar Drops 'Fail' From Class 10 & 12 Marksheets; Replaces It With 'Eligible for Skill Training' By Siddhi Sharma Last Updated: Aug 29, 2026, 10:04 IST BSEB: Bihar Education Minister Mithilesh Tiwari announced that BSEB will replace "Fail" with "Kaushal ke liye patra" ("Eligible for Skill Training") on Class 10/12 marksheets. The policy maintains pass criteria while reducing stress, guiding students toward vocational courses, and providing month-long supplementary prep classes. Bihar Drops 'Fail' From Class 10 & 12 Marksheets; Replaces It With 'Eligible for Skill Training' Register for Result Updates BSEB: The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) is going to replace the discouraging term "Fail" with the positive title "Kaushal ke liye patra" ("Eligible for Skill Training") on the marksheets of Class 10 and Class 12 students. This was announced officially by the Minister of State Education, Mithilesh Tiwari, on 27th August 2026. This educational policy initiative seeks to protect the psychological well-being of the student as well as to reduce their academic stress along with the social stigma of their board examination results. Taking into account the fact that lower academic performance does not determine the overall capabilities of the students, the government of Bihar intends to guide the students towards vocation and career-oriented courses. In order to help these candidates prepare for the supplementary examination, the Education Department is going to conduct one-month special preparation classes before their supplementary examination. Despite the fact that the criteria for passing, pass marks in particular subjects, and divisions have remained unchanged, this educational policy is marked by empathy towards the students. Key Details & Policy Highlights Reason: The Education Department stated that the low mark does not imply the student’s overall ability and future prospects. This measure will be effective in motivating the students to take up different career options. Support Services: For those who sit for supplementary exams, the government will arrange special classes for a month prior to re-sitting for the exams. Criteria for Passing: The fundamental criteria and dividing criteria have not been changed but have been revised in terms of the wording used on board certificates. Classes to be Arranged for One Month for Supplementary Exams According to the minister, the initiative has already received the green signal from Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary, and this will also ensure that month-long special classes are organized for the students who will be taking the matriculation supplementary exam to improve their performance. BBOSE is an autonomous organization formed by the education department of Bihar in the year 2011 for giving all the students an equal chance to perform well. The government of Bihar has also launched the “Vidya Saathi” mobile application for students of Classes 9 to 12. The portal will give the facility of getting connected to the teacher round the clock, with about 75,000 teachers to offer personalized learning assistance. bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar to replace 'Fail' with 'Eligible for Skill Development' in Class 10, 12 marksheets
bihar_raw_news.content: August 29, 2026 Bihar to replace ‘Fail’ with ‘Eligible for Skill Development’ in Class 10, 12 marksheets Copy Link X WhatsApp Share By Pioneer News Service Representational image The Bihar government has decided to replace the word “Fail” with “Eligible for Skill Development” in the marksheets of students appearing for Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations from the current academic session, officials said on Saturday. The move is aimed at helping students who do not clear their examinations pursue vocational training programmes offered by the Bihar Board of Open Schooling and Examination (BBOSE). Education Minister Mithlesh Tiwary said the Education Department would amend the rules and issue necessary instructions to the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB). “Instead of ‘Fail’, the certificates will carry the term ‘Eligible for Skill Development’,” Tiwary told reporters. He said students’ abilities should not be judged solely by their performance in an examination. Tiwary also announced that students appearing for the Class 10 supplementary examinations would be given special one-month sessions to help them prepare better and improve their chances of clearing the examination. The initiative is part of the government’s efforts to provide remedial support and prevent students from falling behind after an unsuccessful examination attempt, officials said. The state government has also been introducing measures to encourage learning beyond conventional classroom teaching. One such initiative is the ‘no-bag day’ on Saturdays in government schools. Under the arrangement announced on August 6, government schools will function from 9.30 am to 1 pm on Saturdays, while their regular timings from Monday to Friday will remain 9.30 am to 4 pm. 0 Likes 0 Dislikes Bookmark 0 Comments Leave a Comment

bihar_raw_news.title: Delhi's Vayo Anand Scheme to Create Recreational Centres for Elderly | Daily Pioneer
bihar_raw_news.content: August 29, 2026 New Delhi scheme targets loneliness with recreation hubs for elderly Copy Link X WhatsApp Share By Rajesh Kumar Loneliness and lack of recreational activities are major reasons for the decline in the health of the elderly. Realising these crucial factors, the national Capital will soon have novel dedicated spaces for them. The Delhi Government is going to launch the Vayo Anand scheme soon for the elderly, where centres will be developed for senior citizens to spend their leisure time, play indoor games, meet and interact with one another and engage in social activities. In a statement, the Chief Minister Rekha Gupta’s office said these centres will provide senior citizens with facilities such as indoor games including carrom and ludo, seating arrangements, fans, coolers, televisions and computers. Newspapers, magazines and books will also be kept at the centres so that senior citizens can make full use of their leisure time. Yoga and meditation classes will also be organised at these centres. In addition, the centres will have monthly medical camps and first-aid kits. The Government will provide financial assistance to organisations running such recreational centres. The scheme was allocated Rs 25 crore in the Delhi Budget 2026-27. According to CM Gupta, senior citizens of Delhi are an invaluable asset to society and that ensuring their dignity, health, active lifestyle and social engagement is a priority of her government. In addition, International Yoga Day, Senior Citizens’ Day and national festivals will be celebrated. At least 5-6 such programmes will be organised at these centres every year. The scheme also provides for monthly medical camps and first-aid kits. Health and fitness classes, outdoor tours, storytelling sessions, painting, craft, pottery, nutritional counselling, and indoor and outdoor games will also be organised. These recreational centres will remain open for at least five days a week and a minimum of seven hours a day. These centres will operate between 7 am and 8 pm. The centres will have adequate ventilation and toilet facilities. Keeping the convenience of senior citizens in mind, preference will also be given to centres located on the ground floor or in buildings equipped with lifts. “Priority will also be given to organising programmes for women, persons with disabilities and transgender senior citizens. In addition, the centres will remain in contact with nearby police stations and hospitals for quick assistance in case of an emergency. Under the scheme, recreational centres must have at least 200 members aged 60 years or above,” the CMO said. The CM under the Vayo Anand scheme, eligible recreational centres will receive financial assistance of 2.40 lakh in a financial year, or Rs 20,000 per month. The amount will be released in two equal half-yearly installments. The assistance will be provided to centres run for senior citizens aged 60 years and above. Operators will have to prioritise providing all the arrangements and facilities mentioned above at their centres. Such centres must be located in Delhi and operate from community spaces. bihar_raw_news.title: NBCC, NHPC sign MoU for pan-India execution of infrastructure projects - The Pioneer
bihar_raw_news.content: August 29, 2026 NBCC, NHPC sign MoU for pan-India execution of infrastructure projects Copy Link X WhatsApp Share By Pioneer News Service NBCC (India) Limited, a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India and NHPC Limited, a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the execution of NHPC’s infrastructure projects, primarily comprising buildings, structures and allied works, on a pan-India basis. The MoU was formalised on 28th August 2026 at NHPC’s corporate office, Faridabad, marking a significant step towards strengthening cooperation between the two leading Navratna CPSEs for the development of modern, robust and sustainable infrastructure across the country. The MoU was signed by Deepak Kumar, general manager (Civil), NHPC, and Rajeev Kumar, chief general manager (Engineering), NBCC, in the presence of senior officials from both organisations. The NBCC delegation included KP Mahadevaswamy, CMD, Anjeev Jain, director (Finance), Vijay Kumar Choudhary, senior ED (Finance), and senior officials from SBG Delhi-II. From NHPC, Bhupender Gupta, CMD, Sanjay Kumar Singh, director (Projects), Suprakash Adhikari, director (Technical), Mahesh Kumar Sharma, director (Finance), RS Ranpara, director (Personnel), and RT Nathan, executive director (HR) were present. Under the MoU, NBCC will provide Project Management Consultancy (PMC) services and undertake specific NHPC infrastructure projects on a deposit work basis. The scope includes design, engineering, project management, procurement, construction, quality control, installation, commissioning and statutory compliances, along with handing over of completed projects. The partnership brings together the complementary strengths of the two organisations. While NHPC brings extensive experience in the hydropower and clean power sectors, NBCC contributes its established expertise in planning and execution of diverse infrastructure projects in accordance with Government guidelines. The collaboration is expected to facilitate standardised and efficient execution of NHPC’s infrastructure projects across India, including residential blocks, residential/commercial infrastructure, office complexes and allied facilities, with emphasis on cost-effectiveness, time-efficiency and requisite quality standards. The MoU marks another important step in strengthening inter-CPSE cooperation and creating a structured framework for delivering efficient, sustainable and future-ready infrastructure across India. 1 Likes 0 Dislikes Bookmark 0 Comments Leave a Comment

bihar_raw_news.title: Bengaluru Danapur Express To Run Daily Soon - Urban Acres
bihar_raw_news.content: Home Cities Bangalore Bengaluru Danapur Express To Run Daily Soon Bangalore Urban news Bengaluru Danapur Express To Run Daily Soon By UrbanPost August 29, 2026 0 Copy URL Facebook Linkedin X WhatsApp Bengaluru Danapur Express To Run Daily Soon Rail connectivity between Bengaluru and Bihar is set to improve as the Danapur–Bengaluru Express will operate daily from September 1, replacing its earlier limited-frequency schedule. The additional services are expected to provide more travel options between southern and eastern India, supporting migrant workers, students, families and other passengers who depend on long-distance rail links. The service connects Bengaluru with Danapur in Bihar and will increase the frequency of trains on the route from the beginning of September. The change comes during a period when passenger movement is expected to rise around the festive season, when demand for long-distance rail travel typically increases. Increasing frequency on an established route can be particularly valuable for passengers travelling between employment centres and their home regions. Bengaluru attracts workers and students from across India, while Bihar is an important source of migrant labour for southern India’s construction, services and other sectors. A daily service also gives passengers greater flexibility. Travellers are less likely to be forced into inconvenient travel dates or rely on more expensive alternatives when demand rises. During major festivals, additional rail capacity can also help reduce pressure on buses and air services. The wider significance lies in Bengaluru’s role as a national employment hub. Stronger rail links with cities and towns outside Karnataka support labour mobility and maintain connections between the metropolitan economy and the communities from which its workforce originates. For long-distance travellers, affordability remains an important consideration. Rail travel generally provides a lower-cost alternative to air travel, particularly for families and passengers carrying substantial luggage. Expanding reliable rail capacity can therefore improve access to employment and education without making mobility dependent on higher-cost transport. There is also a sustainability advantage. A well-utilised long-distance train can move large numbers of passengers using considerably less road space than equivalent individual vehicle journeys. Strengthening rail services can therefore complement broader efforts to shift intercity travel towards more efficient modes. However, the benefits of additional services depend on reliability and station access. Bengaluru passengers need convenient connections between the railway station and the city’s bus and metro networks, while travellers arriving in Bihar also require efficient onward transport. The daily service will also test the railway network’s ability to handle increasing demand. Bengaluru’s rail infrastructure is already under pressure from passenger and freight movements, making timetable coordination and network capacity important as more services are introduced. For the city’s wider transport strategy, the development reinforces the value of strengthening regional and national rail connections alongside metro expansion. Urban public transport can handle local journeys, while dependable intercity trains connect Bengaluru with the wider labour and economic network. From September 1, the additional frequency will give passengers a more consistent rail option between Bengaluru and Danapur. The longer-term opportunity is to build on such connections

national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has left for his four-day visit to Uzbekistan and the Kyrgyz Republic this morning. In his departure statement, Mr Modi expressed confidence that his visit to Uzbekistan and the Kyrgyz Republic will strengthen India’s strategic partnerships in Central Asia and deepen the civilisational connection with the region. He said that in recent years, the India-Uzbekistan Strategic Partnership has seen significant advancement. The Prime Minister said that he is looking forward to having discussions with the President of Uzbekistan, Shavkat Mirziyoyev, on further deepening cooperation in trade and investment, digital connectivity, defence, and energy, and on advancing the shared visions of Viksit Bharat and Yangi Uzbekistan. Mr Modi said that he will also visit the Shastri Memorial and the Mahatma Gandhi Centre at the Tashkent State University of Oriental Studies, which is a tribute to the close cultural and people-to-people ties that bind the two countries. The Prime Minister said that at the invitation of the President of the Kyrgyz Republic, Sadyr Zhaparov, he will travel to Bishkek to participate in the 26th SCO Summit. Mr Modi said that he is looking forward to advancing India’s vision for the region, anchored in Security, Connectivity and Opportunity, and to working with fellow members for a region free from the scourge of terrorism, separatism and extremism, which continue to threaten peace and stability in the neighbourhood and beyond. The Prime Minister said that during his visit to the Kyrgyz Republic, he will also meet President Zhaparov and other SCO leaders and will attend the Opening Ceremony of the 6th World Nomad Games.

national_raw_news.title: 2 hours ago | International 188 Nepal flash floods: Search and rescue operations is on across affected districts of Himalayan nation
national_raw_news.content: The death toll from devastating flash floods in Nepal and Tibet has risen to 626 this morning, with over 2000 people remaining missing. Police have recovered 233 bodies in Chitwan, 158 in Nawalparasi East, 48 in Gorkha, 47 in Nawalparasi West, 45 in Dhading, 41 in Nuwakot, 31 in Tanahun and 13 in Rasuwa. Search and rescue operations are underway across the affected districts of the Himalayan nation. Officials said that the police are coordinating with residents and other agencies to locate missing people and assist those stranded by the floods. Rescued people are being taken from high-risk areas to safer locations. Additionally, the search and rescue officials are working to clear roads blocked by flood debris and landslides to reopen access and facilitate relief operations. The Ministry of External Affairs yesterday said that 320 Indian nationals remain uncontactable or are reportedly missing following the flash flood tragedy on Wednesday. External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said, around 100 people of Indian origin, holding other nationalities also remain uncontactable. Addressing the media in New Delhi, Mr Jaiswal said that 63 Indian nationals working at Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project were rescued from the affected area. Mr Jaiswal said that on the Chinese side, around 400 Indian nationals are safe and in contact with their families. Mr Jaiswal said that the government has set up a control room in the Ministry of External Affairs, which is working round the clock. He said, Indian embassies, both in Kathmandu and Beijing, have also set up 24 X 7 helplines. The facility has been set up to coordinate rescue, relief, and tracking efforts for Indian nationals affected by the disaster. Citizens seeking information or assistance can contact the MEA Control Room via telephone (+91 11 2308 8718, +91 11 2308 8719, +91 11 2301 2113), WhatsApp (+91 9968291988), or email(situationroom@mea.gov.in). The ministry is alslo maintaining round-the-clock coordination through dedicated emergency contact lines operated by the Embassy of India in Kathmandu (+977 985 131 6807, +977 970 910 7500, +977 981 032 6117) and the Embassy of India in Beijing (+86 18514284905). The massive flash flood that struck Nepal’s Rasuwa on Wednesday originated in the Tibetan region of China. It swept through the transboundary Bhote Koshi River, leaving a trail of destruction in the country.

In a social media post, Mr Modi said that Major Dhyan Chand’s brilliance in Indian hockey continues to inspire generations. Extending his greetings to all sports lovers, the Prime Minister said that their dedication, passion and determination make the nation proud. The day celebrates India’s rich sporting heritage and encourages people to make sports a regular part of their daily lives. National Sports Day 2026 is being observed as a three-day nationwide campaign under the pillars of Tribute, Play and Move. This year, National Sports Day is being celebrated under the call, Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein”. Various sporting activities are being organised across the country to mark the occasion. In Delhi, Union Ministers Dr Mansukh Mandaviya and Arjun Ram Meghwal participated in a cricket match under the campaign. Talking to the media, Dr Mandaviya called upon people to spend at least one hour on the playing field every week to remain fit and healthy. He said a fit youth and a healthy society are essential for building a prosperous nation. Mr Meghwal said he plays badminton every day. He said sports help people remain healthy and fit and also help in keeping stress away. The government has been making sustained investments in India’s sporting ecosystem, with the results increasingly visible on the global stage. India’s performances at major international sporting events reflect the country’s growing strength across Olympic, Paralympic and multi-sport disciplines. In the Union Budget 2026-27, over 4400 crore rupees were allocated to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, compared to just around 1200 crore rupees in 2013-14. India’s Olympic journey has witnessed a significant transformation in recent years. The country won two medals at Rio 2016, seven at Tokyo 2020 and six medals at Paris 2024. India’s performance at the Paralympic Games has also improved remarkably. The medal tally rose from four at Rio 2016 to 19 at Tokyo 2020. At Paris 2024, India recorded its best-ever Paralympic performance with 29 medals. India has also consistently improved its performance at the Asian Games. The country won 57 medals at the 2014 Asian Games and improved its tally to 69 in 2018 and scripted history by winning a record 107 medals in 2023. Initiatives such as Khelo India, the Target Olympic Podium Scheme, and Khelo India Rising Talent Identification are strengthening the sporting ecosystem and helping athletes prepare for competition at the highest level.

national_raw_news.title: Petroleum and Natural Gas Ministry clarifies CBG framework under GOBARdhan designed to provide stable price to CBG producers 2 hours ago 43
national_raw_news.content: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas has clarified that the revised pricing framework for Compressed Biogas (CBG) under the GOBARdhan Scheme has been designed to provide a stable and viable price to CBG producers while ensuring that consumers do not face any material increase in CNG and household PNG prices. According to a recent newspaper article, the revised price of Compressed Biogas (CBG) under the GOBARdhan Scheme could place a significant additional burden on CNG and household PNG consumers. However, the Ministry explained that this conclusion does not present the correct picture, as it does not account for the Government’s affordability support and the substantially wider domestic gas pool over which the net cost of CBG will now be distributed. The Ministry explained that under the existing system, the procurement price paid to CBG producers is approximately 1 thousand 478 rupees per Million British thermal units, while the revised procurement price under the GOBARdhan Scheme is 2,110 rupees per Million British thermal units. It noted that the Government will also provide affordability support of 10 rupees per kilogram of CBG, equivalent to around 215 rupees per Million British thermal units with 95 per cent methane content, reducing the effective cost to approximately 1,895 rupees per Million British thermal units. Additionally, CBG will be pooled with other domestically produced natural gas, with its net cost spread across a significantly larger domestic gas pool, approximately 2.5 to 3 times the earlier base. The Ministry highlighted that this wider pooling mechanism will substantially minimise the impact on individual CNG and household PNG consumers. The Ministry further emphasized that the revised pricing framework has been carefully designed to balance two key objectives. These include ensuring a stable and viable price for CBG producers to enable sustainable plant operations, while Government-funded affordability support and a substantially wider gas pool protect consumers from any material impact on prices.

national_raw_news.title: Telangana Deputy CM directs Singareni officials to explore joint venture with Karnataka’s Hatti for future gold mining projects 4 hours ago 45
national_raw_news.content: Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Bhatti Vikramarka has directed Singareni officials to explore a joint venture with Karnataka’s Hatti Gold Mines for future gold mining projects. He gave these instructions during a visit to the Hatti and UTI gold mines in Raichur district, Karnataka, on the second day of his tour to the region. The Deputy CM, who also holds the Finance and Energy portfolios, said combining the technical expertise of both public sector companies could improve India’s domestic gold production. He noted that Hatti Gold Mines has vast experience in gold exploration, mining, processing and refining, and suggested that Singareni’s technical skills in coal and mineral mining be combined with this experience. Bhatti Vikramarka said gold plays a key role in the country’s economic security, and government companies like Singareni should take the lead in scientifically exploring domestic gold reserves to reduce import dependence. During the visit, he inspected the production unit, mineral processing centre and electro-winning unit at Hatti Gold Mines. Officials told him the project currently produces two to four kilograms of gold daily. He also visited the UTI open-cast and underground gold mines, and asked officials about mining technology, transport and worker safety. Singareni CMD Dr Buddha Prakash Jyothi and other senior officials accompanied him on the tour.

national_raw_news.title: 3rd Vande Bharat train between Jammu and Srinagar will be launched soon: Jitendra Singh 5 hours ago 67
national_raw_news.content: Union Minister of State for Science and Technology and Earth Sciences, Dr Jitendra Singh, said that the third Vande Bharat train between Jammu and Srinagar will be launched soon, terming it a major development for the people of Jammu and Kashmir. Akashvani Jammu Correspondent reports that in a video message, Dr Singh said that the Ministry of Railways has also approved a halt at Udhampur following a demand raised by the public. He said the approval for the Udhampur halt was particularly significant, as it was earlier believed that a stop there would not be feasible. Singh also thanked Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the Ministry of Railways and the Railway Minister for the development. Reflecting on the expansion of the railway network in Jammu and Kashmir, Singh said that when the Jammu railway station was established in 1972, it took nearly five decades for the railway network to advance further into the region. He said the expansion gained momentum after Narendra Modi became Prime Minister, with railway connectivity extended to Kathua and subsequently to Udhampur and the Kashmir Valley. Singh further said that railway connectivity to the Kashmir Valley was once considered difficult because of the mountainous terrain, but the project was completed despite several challenges. He also highlighted the construction of the world’s highest railway bridge over the Chenab River in Reasi as a major engineering achievement. He said the railway journey has also emerged as an attraction for tourists, with many visitors travelling by train from Jammu to Srinagar to experience the scenic beauty along the route.
